evidence.citation: “Run a fresh blind re-evaluation of all three cases—A, B, and C—using one context-free runner per case,” with evidence that “B passes,” “A and C still pass,” and that “The live checkout was swept after each run for leaks or unintended changes.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: Re-running B validates the targeted fix, while re-running A and C checks for regressions. Blind, isolated runners and post-run checkout sweeps protect evaluation integrity and reproducibility, so the required work is necessary under the supplied bar.
